verdict.rationale: WooCommerce ships a default Storefront theme and docs mention early decisions on homepage design, menus, and site structure (docs-31/39), suggesting themeable storefronts exist, but the only documented customization method for Storefront explicitly requires inserting HTML/PHP/JavaScript via add_action() hooks (docs-9/45) — the opposite of 'without code.' No evidence of a native no-code visual builder, drag-and-drop section editor, or branding controls for merchants. missing for 10: evidence of a no-code/drag-and-drop page builder or customizer, evidence of multiple professionally designed theme options, evidence that branding/section customization can be done without touching code.
